AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 (FSR 1), unmodified: `ffx_a.h` and
`ffx_fsr1.h` from https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR
(`ffx-fsr/`, branch master), MIT license (`LICENSE.txt`).

Used by the Vulkan shim's scaling pass (`shim/scaler/`, `shim/scaler.c`):
EASU upscales a game's picture to its window, RCAS sharpens it.
